question: Should context-padding-only static evidence stay reviewer-only when the final GitHub-backed ClawScan verdict is clean, or should it intentionally mark the public skill row suspicious?
rationale: The PR changes the boundary between deterministic static evidence, final ClawScan verdicts, installability, and public browse/search visibility; that policy cannot be inferred safely from the patch alone.

options.title: Keep Padding Evidence Reviewer-Only
options.body: Route the detector through durable ClawScan and retain context-padding evidence without setting public suspicious state when the final GitHub verdict is clean.

options.title: Approve Public Suspicious Visibility
options.body: Allow padding-only evidence to mark GitHub-backed rows suspicious, but require explicit spec coverage, focused tests, and runtime proof of browse/search/install impact.

options.title: Pause Until Scan Policy Is Settled
options.body: Keep the PR draft or close it in favor of a narrower maintainer-sponsored security design if the team is not ready to choose the policy.

recommendation.title: Keep Padding Evidence Reviewer-Only
recommendation.body: Route the detector through durable ClawScan and retain context-padding evidence without setting public suspicious state when the final GitHub verdict is clean.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-history owner for the GitHub-backed ClawScan flow and related spec invariant.
